purpose: Must-fire and must-stay-quiet spellings for the architecture rules that close a class of mistake (SL-001 m5, m6, m11, m3, M-add-1, m1). Each rule is run over each row's text at each row's path, with the rule's files glob and except_files applied. A rule is not pinned until it has both kinds of row.

bounded_by.request-derived scheme and host (m6): Ordinary handler code in which the request is named r, req or request: the Host field, the TLS field, URL.Host and URL.Scheme, the Referer accessor, and Header.Get, Header.Values or an index with the key host, origin or referer in any letter case, in double quotes or backticks, with or without spaces inside the call. Not bounded: a request under another name, a header key assembled at run time, a header map copied to a variable first. The structural answer for those is that no handler is given a URL builder other than the one that reads the configured base URL.
bounded_by.redirect-writing (m11, M-add-1): Every way ordinary code answers a redirect: http.Redirect, http.RedirectHandler, a Set, Add or index write of the Location key in any letter case with double quotes or backticks, any of the five redirect status constants, and a numeric 30x passed to WriteHeader. The only file allowed to do so is internal/auth/next.go. Not bounded: a key or status held in a variable, http.ResponseController, a reverse proxy.
bounded_by.escaping bypass (m5): Ordinary ways site HTML skips html/template: importing text/template under any import spelling, importing html/template under an alias or dot (which hides typed conversions from the conversion pattern), a typed conversion to any of the seven template types, and a Go string literal, interpreted or raw, that starts with markup. Not bounded: markup assembled from pieces, bytes read from a file and written as they are.
bounded_by.sign-in control shape (m3): A form element whose action attribute, or a button whose formaction attribute, names the sign-in URL, in a template file, with any quoting and any letter case. Not bounded: an action built from template variables that hide the path.
